```{r download-data}
data_filename <- "data/autism.csv"
if (!file.exists(data_filename)) {
  dir.create("data")
  download.file("https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005385.s001", data_filename)
}
```

```{r read-data}
library(readr)
col_names <- names(read_csv(data_filename, n_max = 1, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())))
autism <- read_csv(data_filename, skip = 2, col_names = col_names, col_types = cols(
  .default = col_double(),
  Group = col_character()
)) %>% mutate(
  Group = as_factor(Group)
)
```

## Python

```{r}
library(reticulate)
py_discover_config()
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.compose import make_column_transformer
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
```


```{python}
autism = r.autism
```


```{python}
autism.shape
```


```{python}
autism.info()
```


```{python}
autism['Group'].value_counts().to_frame()
```



```{python}
autism.iloc[:, 1:-1]
```


```{r}
data <- 
  autism %>% 
  select(-`Vineland ABC`) %>% 
  filter(Group != "SIB") %>% 
  mutate(Group = factor(Group))
```


```{python}
data = r.data
y = data['Group']
X = data.drop(['Group'], axis=1)
clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter = 1e6)
clf.fit(X, y)
```

```{python}
clf.intercept_
```
